verdict.rationale: Vendor docs specify core counts (18-core, 12 Prime+6 Performance) and boost clocks (up to 5.0GHz) supporting the compile/parallel-jobs claim, but the story explicitly requires corroboration by independent multi-core benchmarks, and community discussion directly states none exist ('Not a single benchmark even against the previous generation... best to wait for independent reviews'), and the product hasn't shipped yet (2026 availability). missing for 10: independent/third-party multi-core benchmark results, hands-on compile-time or parallel-workload tests, real TDP/thermal data needed to sustain boost clocks.
